definitions.gloss: attentive listening, active listening, careful listening
definitions.explanation: Listening to someone earnestly and with full attention. A key concept in counseling, business communication, and interpersonal skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾聴|けいちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To listen attentively to the other person.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "to incline one's ear" (⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧ + ⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧). Has become a buzzword in business and counseling. {傾聴|けいちょう} implies more than just hearing — it involves empathy, attention, and engagement with the speaker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傾聴|けいちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to listen attentively
- {傾聴|けいちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: attitude of active listening
- {傾聴|けいちょう}{力|りょく}: listening ability
- {傾聴|けいちょう}⟦スキル→スキル：08815_sukiru⟧: active listening skills
